daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent technical indicators agree — for example, momentum (RSI), trend direction (MACD), price structure (above a moving average), and participation (volume surge) all pointing the same way. Relying on just one signal can produce false alarms, but when four line up together it's a much stronger sign that real buying interest is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標同時指向同一方向時才進場，例如動能指標（RSI）、趨勢方向（MACD）、價格結構（高於移動平均線）及參與度（成交量放大）全部一致。只依賴單一訊號容易出現假訊號，但當四項指標同時出現時，就更能確認背後有真實的買盤支持。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, reflecting a broadly risk-on but not euphoric tone across markets. No standout news catalyst was flagged for today's session, suggesting the move was driven by steady buying interest rather than a single headline event. Breadth favored growth and momentum names, which is consistent with several of today's top-scoring screener candidates.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍錄得溫和升幅，納斯達克指數上升0.8%，標普500指數上升0.7%，反映市場氣氛整體偏向風險胃納提升，但未見過度亢奮。今日未見特別突出的新聞觸發因素，顯示升勢較大機會由持續買盤支持，而非單一事件帶動。資金流向偏好增長及動能股，與今日篩選榜上多隻高分股份的表現一致。
